<function name="AlignAngles" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">
	<description>Rotates the object so that it's angles are aligned to the ones inputted.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="from" type="Angle"></arg>
		<arg name="to" type="Angle"></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle"></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
